Government MPs have defended the prime minister as criticism mounted over last month’s remarks, branded by the Coalition opposition as “grubby”. The ass.

ABC News: Furor over Albanese's melons joke could force Japan into drama it wanted to avoid. ABC News reports that for a month the Japanese government has studiously remained quiet on Anthony Albanese's melons "joke".

But the media frenzy in Australia could be a response it didn't want to make.

stories.title: Virtue and a Sledgehammer – take a literal hammer to your past
stories.summary:
Virtue and a Sledgehammer – take a literal hammer to your past. What do you do when you return to your home town, with your dead mother in your car boot, to find the inhabitants have been turned into robots?

In the boot of her car, Pratelle carries the corpse of her mother and a giant sledgehammer.

Her mission is simple: take the hammer to her home town. As you enter shops and homes through the door and leave them through the opposite wall, it becomes clear that the robots who either attack you or flee are all digital versions of your old neighbours.
